title: Actions related to reception of NotificationMessageSidelink message

entities.name: NotificationMessageSidelink
entities.description: A sidelink message received by U2N Remote UE that triggers specific actions based on UE type and state.

entities.name: indicationType
entities.description: An optional information element included in NotificationMessageSidelink that determines the required actions.

entities.name: L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: Condition where the UE is an L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED state.

entities.name: L3 U2N Remote UE
entities.description: Condition where the UE is an L3 U2N Remote UE.

entities.name: L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: Condition where the UE is an L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE state.

entities.name: PC5-RRC connection released
entities.description: Condition where the PC5-RRC connection with the U2N Relay UE is determined to be released.

entities.name: RRC connection re-establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED when indicationType is included.

entities.name: PC5-RRC connection release
entities.description: Procedure performed when PC5-RRC connection is determined to be released for L3 U2N Remote UE or L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE.

entities.name: Maintain PC5-RRC connection
entities.description: Behavior where the UE maintains the PC5-RRC connection when release condition is not met.

relations.description: NotificationMessageSidelink may contain the indicationType information element.
Condition of L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED establishes initiation of RRC connection re-establishment procedure.
Condition of L3 U2N Remote UE guards the check for PC5-RRC connection release determination.
Condition of L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE guards the check for PC5-RRC connection release determination.
Condition of PC5-RRC connection being released establishes the PC5-RRC connection release procedure.
Negation of PC5-RRC connection release condition guards the maintenance of PC5-RRC connection.
